status_rule: Blocked if any required check fails on a named assertion; otherwise Incomplete if any required check was skipped, timed out or crashed; otherwise Demonstrated checks passed.

planted_faults.title: Confirmed shown without a receipt
planted_faults.what: When the receipt request fails, the app falls back to the transaction lookup and treats a known transaction as confirmed, although it is still waiting in the mempool.

planted_faults.title: Admin function open to everyone
planted_faults.what: setAllowlisted lacks onlyAdmin. The interface hides the control, the contract does not refuse it.

planted_faults.title: Retry pays a second time
planted_faults.what: After status unknown, the retry button sends a new payment instead of checking the first one, which is still pending. Nothing remembers the payment in progress: the Pay button stays active, a reload forgets it, and the contract accepts the same payment intent twice.

checks.title: Wallet connects on the right chain

rule.text: The balance a user sees is the balance the chain holds.

trace.forbidden: A displayed balance that differs from the chain.
trace.criterion: After connecting, the app shows the wallet's account, the local chain, and a TEST balance equal to the balance on chain.

rule.text: Nothing is sent without the user's signature.

trace.forbidden: A transaction or a nonce change after a refusal.
trace.criterion: When the user refuses in the wallet (code 4001), the app says so and no transaction reaches the node.

rule.text: Payments are only sent on the intended chain.

trace.allowed: Switch back to the local chain.
trace.forbidden: A send attempt while the wallet is on another chain.
trace.criterion: On another chain the app shows a banner, disables payment, sends nothing, and clears the banner after switching back.

assertions.name: terms_signed_before_transaction
assertions.observed: personal_sign at call 3, eth_sendTransaction at call 6

rule.text: Demo terms v0 must be accepted before any payment.

trace.forbidden: A payment before the terms, or an acceptance record signed by another key.
trace.criterion: Payment stays locked until the demo terms are signed, and a forced click on the locked button sends nothing; the signature precedes the transaction; the API keeps a verified record and refuses a forged one.
trace.method: Playwright forced click, wallet call log, API

evidence.caller: outsider (not allowlisted, holds TEST, has approved)
evidence.path: eth_sendTransaction straight to the node, no interface

rule.text: Only allowlisted wallets may open a grant.

trace.forbidden: A non-allowlisted wallet opening a grant by skipping the interface.
trace.criterion: A wallet outside the allowlist calling the contract directly is reverted with NotAllowlisted and no grant is created.
trace.method: Direct contract call from a non-allowlisted account

checks.title: Reverted payment is shown as failed

rule.text: A failed payment is never presented as done.

trace.allowed: A mined, reverted transaction that costs gas.
trace.forbidden: Moved tokens or a success message after a revert.
trace.criterion: With an empty TEST balance and a fixed gas limit, the transaction is mined with status 0, token balances do not move, the native balance drops by the fee only, and the app says failed.
trace.method: Playwright, fixed gas limit, direct chain reads

checks.title: Success is confirmed only after the block

assertions.name: no_confirmed_before_block
observed: submitted "Pending: waiting for the network to include it" at -1.00s

assertions.name: api_matches_chain
assertions.observed: API grant #1 active, owner 0x70997970c51812dc3a010c7d01b50e0d17dc79c8, paid 25 TEST

ui_history: submitted "Pending: waiting for the network to include it" at -1.00s

rule.text: Confirmed means included in a block.

trace.forbidden: Confirmed before the block, or an API that disagrees with the chain.
trace.criterion: Nothing says confirmed before the block is mined; then the receipt is status 1, 25 TEST move once, the grant is active on chain and the API agrees.
trace.method: Playwright, manual mining, direct chain reads

checks.title: No confirmed without a receipt during an RPC outage

rule.text: Confirmed means included in a block.

trace.allowed: Pending or status unknown, then Confirmed after the block.
trace.forbidden: Confirmed at any moment while no receipt exists.
trace.criterion: While receipt requests from the app are cut, the screen never shows the word confirmed: no receipt exists and no block has been mined. Once the bench restores the RPC and mines, both versions end on Confirmed, so only the history can tell them apart.
trace.method: RPC proxy cuts receipts on the app's path until the screen settles, plus a margin; full history of the status line, state and visible text

checks.title: One payment per intent, however the user retries

assertions.name: outage_shown_as_unknown
assertions.observed: unknown: "Status unknown: the network did not answer"

assertions.name: retry_checks_same_transaction
assertions.observed: 6 receipt or transaction lookups for the first transaction in the 1.5 s after the retry
assertions.expected: at least 1 lookup for the first transaction

assertions.name: retry_sends_no_new_payment
assertions.observed: 1 eth_sendTransaction from the app; 1 payment transaction: nonce 1 waiting in the mempool

assertions.name: pay_during_unknown_pays_once
assertions.observed: 1 payment transaction: nonce 2 block 11 status 0x1, -25 TEST

assertions.name: reload_resumes_same_transaction
assertions.observed: after reload the status line follows the pending transaction: idle, submitted, unknown

assertions.name: reload_then_pay_pays_once
assertions.observed: 1 payment transaction: nonce 3 block 12 status 0x1, -25 TEST

assertions.name: double_click_pays_once
assertions.observed: 1 payment transaction: nonce 4 block 13 status 0x1, -25 TEST

ui_history: submitted "Pending: waiting for the network to include it" at +0.02s
unknown "Status unknown: the network did not answer" at +0.53s
submitted "Pending: waiting for the network to include it" at +0.56s

same_intent_replay.path: eth_sendTransaction straight to the node, no interface

trace.forbidden: A second payment transaction for the same intent, successful or reverted.
trace.criterion: After status unknown, the retry looks up the same transaction again and the screen ends on Confirmed; clicking Pay during unknown, reloading then paying, and double clicking each leave exactly one payment transaction (mined or reverted) and a single 25 TEST debit; the contract refuses the same intent sent again with IntentAlreadyPaid.
trace.method: RPC proxy outage, retry, Pay during unknown, reload, double click; direct block and mempool scan; direct contract call

checks.title: Admin function enforced by the contract

assertions.name: allowlist_unchanged
assertions.observed: outsider allowlisted false, user_low allowlisted true
assertions.expected: outsider allowlisted false, user_low allowlisted true

assertions.name: admin_can_edit_allowlist
assertions.observed: admin panel shown; add status 0x1, remove status 0x1
assertions.expected: admin panel shown; add status 0x1, remove status 0x1

evidence.path: eth_sendTransaction straight to the node, no interface

rule.text: Only the admin edits the allowlist.

trace.forbidden: Any other account adding or removing an address by calling the contract.
trace.criterion: The admin control is hidden for ordinary users; an allowlisted ordinary account calling setAllowlisted directly, to add or to remove, is reverted with NotAdmin and the allowlist does not change; the admin can still add and remove.
trace.method: Direct contract calls from an allowlisted ordinary account, then from the admin

checks.title: Revoked access is refused once indexed

evidence.reader_identity: simulated: declared in the x-reader-address request header, no reader sign-in

rule.text: Revoked access ends once the revocation is indexed.

trace.allowed: Read while the grant is active.
trace.forbidden: Serving the data after the revocation is mined and indexed.
trace.criterion: With the reader's identity simulated by a request header (the demo has no reader sign-in), the API serves the dataset to the granted reader only, and refuses it once the revocation is mined and indexed.
trace.method: Playwright revoke, indexer catch-up, API requests; the reader's identity is simulated by a request header

not_covered.item: Real wallet extensions and mobile wallets
not_covered.why: The bench drives an EIP-1193 test provider. It proves the app's logic, not compatibility with MetaMask, Rabby, WalletConnect or a phone wallet.
The reader's identity is simulated: the API trusts the address declared in a request header. C11 shows that the API applies the grant state to that identity, not that the caller owns it.

not_covered.item: Economic and security audit of the contract
not_covered.why: The checks prove three rules the contract enforces on its own (allowlist, admin role, one payment per intent). They are not an audit: no fuzzing, no invariant testing, no review of upgrade or oracle risk.

not_covered.item: Gas spikes and congestion on a public network
not_covered.why: The local chain mines on demand. Stuck, replaced or cancelled transactions under real fee markets are not exercised.
Confirmed here means included in one block. A block that is later dropped is not simulated.

not_covered.item: Legal drafting of the terms and the allowlist
not_covered.why: The rules are fictitious demo rules. The bench checks that the app enforces them, not that they are the right rules.

not_covered.item: Load, many users at once, indexer restarts
not_covered.why: Each check runs one user on a fresh chain snapshot.
Not assessed. This run tests a synthetic app built to carry three known faults.

decision: The bench fills in the technical result only. The rules marked fictitious were written for this demo and approved by no one; go or no-go is a person's decision, taken with this report in hand.
